correctness.rationale: The eight octahedral facets have area sqrt(3)/2 and normals (±1,±1,±1)/sqrt(3), so Cauchy projection gives B=(1/4)Σ|±a±b±c|=max(2a,a+b+c) for sorted 0≤c≤b≤a. On a fixed largest-coordinate sphere section, the permitted azimuth is [phi0,π/4], phi0=acos(a/sqrt(1-a²)) below 1/sqrt(2), else zero. Haar area d a d phi makes this angle uniformly distributed after conditioning; with Ψ=π/4−phi, b+c=sqrt(2(1-a²))cos Ψ. Pushforward yields B=2a+(sqrt(2(1-a²))cos Ψ−a)_+, stated support and explicit atom. Derivative gives density 1/[q(a)sqrt(2(1-a²)−(z−a)²)]; integrating the positive part yields the mean. At a=1/sqrt(3) and a=1 only the one-sided regular-conditional limits are asserted. These analytic identities prove the continuum, not the directional samples.
